tool_summary: Configures Gatekeeper, macOS's code-signing and notarization enforcement system that controls which applications are permitted to run.

rules.description: The --master-disable flag (or --global-disable on newer macOS) turns off Gatekeeper's code-signing assessment entirely, allowing unsigned or unnotarized applications to run without warning.
rules.reversible_note: Reversible via --master-enable, but any unsigned code executed in the interim is not undone by re-enabling.

rules.description: The --add subcommand whitelists a specific application path, exempting it from Gatekeeper assessment going forward without disabling protection system-wide.
rules.reversible_note: Reversible via --remove, but any execution of the whitelisted app in the interim is not undone.

rules.description: Queries or modifies Gatekeeper configuration or assessment policy. Known status queries reveal only a boolean and are low-value reconnaissance, but severity here is WARNING rather than INFO so that any unrecognized or future spctl subcommand surfaces for review rather than silently passing as benign.
